title: TodayWeather for Android · Withdraw usage analytics
scenario: An Android device in an opt-in region, with usage analytics previously allowed. The screenshots show the app in English.

steps.title: Withdraw permission
steps.instruction: Open the side menu, select Usage analytics, and choose Decline / withdraw.
steps.caption: The Usage analytics dialog shows progress while the app saves your choice.
steps.expected: Collection stops immediately. Wait for the progress dialog to close.

steps.title: Confirm the saved choice
steps.instruction: Check the Usage analytics row in the side menu after the progress dialog closes.
steps.caption: The row shows Off after the withdrawal is saved.
steps.expected: Usage analytics stays off after a restart. If the app shows a save error, repeat the withdrawal.
